politique_de_confidentialite_et_protecti: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Protection — Luna Astralis
luna_astralis_accorde_une_importance_par: Luna Astralis places particular importance on the protection of privacy and the respect of its users' personal data. This policy describes the methods of collection, use, and protection of personal data, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
le_responsable_du_traitement_des_donnees: The data controller for personal data is:
selon_l_utilisation_du_service_les_donne: Depending on the use of the service, the following data may be processed:
donnees_de_compte_lorsqu_un_compte_est_c: Account data (when an account is created)
messages_echanges_avec_l_outil_d_explora: Messages exchanged with the exploration tool
donnees_techniques_necessaires_au_foncti: Technical data necessary for the operation of the site (e.g., browser, device, technical logs)
les_donnees_personnelles_sont_utilisees_: Personal data is used solely for:
permettre_l_acces_aux_fonctionnalites_pr: Allowing access to the offered features
assurer_la_securite_et_la_stabilite_du_s: Ensuring the security and stability of the site
aucune_donnee_n_est_utilisee_a_des_fins_: No data is used for medical, therapeutic, or psychological diagnosis purposes.
le_traitement_des_donnees_personnelles_r: The processing of personal data is based on:
l_execution_du_service_demande: The execution of the requested service
l_interet_legitime_lie_au_fonctionnement: The legitimate interest related to the operation, security, and improvement of the service
le_service_s_appuie_sur_des_prestataires: The service relies on technical providers who may process certain data on behalf of Luna Astralis:
generation_des_reponses_de_l_outil: — generation of responses from the tool
ces_prestataires_agissent_en_tant_que_so: These providers act as subcontractors and apply their own security and regulatory compliance measures.
certaines_donnees_peuvent_etre_traitees_: Some data may be processed on servers located outside the European Union. Where applicable, appropriate safeguards are put in place in accordance with GDPR requirements.
les_donnees_personnelles_sont_conservees: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the operation of the service or to comply with applicable legal obligations.
